classifications.rationale: The President is the actor and presently makes the statutory determination required concerning the action to be taken on the USITC report; the determination occurs in this segment even though the selected remedy is detailed afterward.
classifications.evidence: I have determined the action I will take with respect to the report of the United States International Trade Commission

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the substantive statutory national-economic-interest determination supporting import relief and specifies the tariff remedy he will proclaim; the legally consequential presidential determination occurs now, with proclamation as later implementation.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that granting import relief is consistent with our national economic interest.

classifications.rationale: The President directs the Trade Representative to monitor and review the relief, consult, obtain advice, and propose possible changes; it does not itself alter the tariff relief or require a specified later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: you are to undertake such a review in two years
